overview_description.description: Rootly provides incident management solutions designed to streamline operations and reduce response times for organizations. Their platform helps teams manage incidents efficiently by automating processes, creating structured workflows, and enabling real-time collaboration. Rootly’s system integrates with existing tools to centralize information, allowing teams to respond quickly and resolve issues with minimal disruption. By offering features like post-incident analysis and automated alerts, Rootly supports organizations in improving operational resilience and reducing downtime. The platform is tailored to support teams in managing complex incidents while maintaining alignment with broader business goals.

about_short_description.short_description: Rootly provides incident management solutions designed to streamline operations and reduce response times for organizations.

product.name: Rootly On-Call
product.description: A multi-cloud on-call scheduling and alerting platform integrated with Slack for managing on-call rotations, escalations, and notifications.

product.name: Rootly Incident Response
product.description: A platform to orchestrate incident response by automating incident creation, team assembly, communication, and task management within Slack.

product.name: Rootly Post-Incident Learning
product.description: A tool to facilitate post-incident retrospectives by automating timeline creation, generating reports, and tracking follow-ups using AI.

product.name: Rootly Status Pages
product.description: A service to create and manage status pages for communicating service health and incident updates to customers and stakeholders.

product.name: Rootly AI
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that supports incident management by providing natural language reports, troubleshooting guidance, and automated retrospective documentation.

product.name: Rootly Integrations
product.description: A collection of integrations connecting Rootly with popular tools like Slack, Jira, Zoom, and monitoring platforms to streamline incident workflows.
